note: Synthetic labelled emails for the Jev email lanes. Every case is invented; none is real correspondence, so this file is safe to commit and to send to a third party. Labels are the intended answer, frozen before any run: edit the wording of the questions, never these. Cases carrying a `waiting` array stand in for waiting-on rows Cove already held open against that sender.
